tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/tls-verification.md <<'EOF'
# TLS certificate verification

The project's recorded decision is that TLS certificate verification applies to all builds, development builds included, so there is no build in which certificates go unverified. This sits alongside the recorded rule that HTTPS is used everywhere, with no plaintext exceptions.
EOF
cat docs/policies/tls-verification.md
